warnings.desc: For the ILLAWARRA COAST, including WOLLONGONG: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 55 to 65 km/h with peak gusts around 90 km/h are possible from later this evening into early Tuesday morning. For the remainder of the GREAT DIVIDING RANGE: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 70 km/h with peak gusts around 100 km/h are likely, gradually easing below warning thresholds during Tuesday morning. Locations which may be affected include Wollongong, Armidale, Goulburn, Nowra, Katoomba, Bowral, Braidwood, Dorrigo, Drake

warnings.title: Severe Weather Warning for East Gippsland
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 70 km/h with peak gusts of around 90 km/h are possible from Monday evening about the Gippsland coastline east of Orbost. Winds are expected to ease by sunrise Tuesday morning. Several Flood Watches and Warnings are current for Victoria. Please refer to https://www.bom.gov.au/weather-and-climate/warnings-and-alerts Locations which may be affected include Mallacoota.
